text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while preparing for the 
long-awaited Aoharu Cup main tournament, 
Little Cocon visited the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...It's really not that big of a deal, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That's assuming your team makes it to the 
Aoharu Cup finals...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"I will never forgive you if you run a 
half-assed race. There's no point unless 
we clash with everything we've got."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's all. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what a coincidence! Did you come here 
to declare war too?!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hah!? N-Not really... that's not it!
